copy.headline: "There's nothing to eat" is almost always a lie.
copy.body: Here's the technique that proves it.

copy.headline: Open your fridge.
items: Pull out every vegetable that's about to turn.
Any combination works: bell peppers, zucchini, broccoli, sweet potato, onion, carrots, mushrooms — literally anything.

copy.headline: Chop it roughly.
items: Toss with olive oil + salt + whatever spices you have.

copy.headline: Add a protein if you have one:
items: chicken thighs, sausage, tofu, canned chickpeas.
All of them work. None of them are required.

copy.headline: This technique turns "I have nothing" into dinner in 30 minutes.
copy.body: The only ingredient is whatever's about to die in your fridge.
